text: Motherhood brings a thousand questions. Maya brings them into one supportive space.
Let's begin with Jenny. Pregnancy or postpartum; week, month, or due date. She chooses week twenty-two, then adds vegetarian preferences, a dairy allergy, and heartburn. Her journey now has context.
Four priorities: her pregnancy stage; iron and calcium for nutrition; a pause to recharge for energy; and comfort and balance for movement. A clearer place to start.
Her body's changing rhythm explains illustrative hormone patterns, with a little attention to her, too.
Then, a little wonder: a grapefruit-sized glimpse, approximate measurements, and a discovery about her baby.
But what does she do next? This Week gathers her priorities.
Nutrition turns source-linked guidance into food choices, with nutrient references and her dairy allergy clearly in view.
Movement makes staying active more approachable, with practical options and adaptations.
Symptoms start with her heartburn; self-love makes room for her; FAQs answer common questions.
Select Balanced Week. Build the plan. Maya brings meals, movement, and self-care into one Monday-to-Sunday view, helping Jenny turn guidance into an everyday routine.
Questions don't follow a timetable. Open Ask Maya.
First, meal options with her allergy. Retrieval-augmented generation uses relevant passages from our knowledge library, alongside her context. The response includes source references.
Make those vegan. This follow-up continues the same conversation, without asking Jenny to repeat her story.
Next, her reported heartburn. Practical comfort measures come with signs that deserve medical attention.
Now an urgent question. Maya stops ordinary advice and directs her to immediate medical help.
Finally, an API-key request. Maya refuses to disclose credentials: support, with clear boundaries.
Maya. A clearer next step—and room for wonder.
